name: story-to-manga
title_zh: 文字转漫画，分镜对白字稿一步到位
tagline_zh: 把口述史、民间故事或说明文变成忠实原作的漫画成品。自动产出制作脚本、分镜提示词、对话气泡与确定性字稿，不靠感觉乱画。
tagline_en: Turn testimony, folklore, or explainers into source-faithful manga—script, panel prompts, balloons, and.
desc_en: Convert supplied stories, testimony, folklore, primary-source material, or explanatory text into a source-faithful manga, including production script, continuity-anchored art generation, speech balloons, and deterministic lettering. Use when the user asks to manga-ize, comic-adapt, storyboard, panelize, typeset, or visually dramatize supplied prose, or invokes $story-to-manga.
why_zh: 它锚定连续性：分镜、对白、字稿都从同一份源文本推导，画面不会越改越跑偏，适合需要逐格核对原意的改编。
why_en: It anchors continuity: panels, dialogue, and lettering derive from one source text, so visuals stay faithful when iterating.
limit_zh: 只认输入的纯文字材料，不处理已有分镜脚本或图片草稿；输出为制作脚本与画面提示词，不直接生成最终漫画图像。
limit_en: Input must be plain prose; no existing scripts or image drafts. Outputs production script and prompts only—no final art, requires a separate renderer.
title_en: Prose to manga with script, panels, and lettering
